name: deepline_ads_search
description: Ad Intelligence — a company's active ads on Facebook, Google, LinkedIn, or TikTok (via Adyntel): creative copy, spend signals, and targeting. Cost: ~$0.02/call [spec].

platform.description: Ad platform to query for active ads.

domain.description: Company domain in normalized form (for example company.com, no https:// or www). Required for facebook, google, and linkedin.

keyword.description: Keyword to search the TikTok ad library. Required for tiktok (brand name works well).

media_type.description: Optional Google ad format filter (google only).

country_code.description: Optional TikTok country filter (tiktok only): a European country code or "ALL". Omit for global results.

name: deepline_company_enrich
description: Enrich Company — merged 30+ field profile from Apollo, Crustdata, and PeopleDataLabs: revenue, headcount, industry, funding, valuation, tech stack, social profiles, SIC/NAICS codes, HQ address. Cost: ~$0.10/call [spec].

domain.description: Company domain to enrich (for example stripe.com).

company_name.description: Company name fallback when domain is unavailable.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn company page id or full company URL.

name: deepline_contacts_by_role
description: Find Decision Makers — accumulate contacts at a company matching the given roles (and optional seniority) across Dropleads, Apollo, Icypeas, Prospeo, and Crustdata. Cost: ~$0.25/call [spec].

roles.description: Primary persona intent for contact lookup, e.g. ["VP Engineering", "Head of Security"].

company_name.description: Company name for human context and provider fallbacks.

domain.description: Company domain for contact lookup (for example acme.com).

linkedin_company_url.description: Optional LinkedIn company URL in /company/ format for domain-less lookup.

limit.description: Optional result cap per waterfall step (1–100). Use 1 for cheapest lookups.

name: deepline_email_from_linkedin
description: Email from LinkedIn — waterfall search (Findymail, Prospeo, Lusha, …) that resolves a LinkedIn profile URL into a verified work email. Cost: ~$0.17/call [spec].

linkedin_url.description: Standard LinkedIn profile URL in /in/ format.

name: deepline_email_personal
description: Find Personal Email — waterfall search (Dropleads, LeadMagic, PeopleDataLabs) for a personal email address. Best coverage with a LinkedIn URL plus first and last name. Cost: ~$0.10/call [spec].

name: deepline_email_validate
description: Validate Email — ZeroBounce deliverability check for an email address (valid / catch-all / invalid). Cost: ~$0.03/call [spec].

ip_address.description: Optional signup IP address used by ZeroBounce for enrichment.

name: deepline_email_work
description: Find Work Email — waterfall search across 79+ providers (Apollo, Hunter, Prospeo, …) for a verified work email from a name and company domain. Stops at the first provider that returns a hit. Cost: ~$0.04/call [spec].

linkedin_url.description: Optional standard LinkedIn profile URL — enables LinkedIn-native fallback providers.

name: deepline_linkedin_find
description: Find LinkedIn Profile — resolve a person into their LinkedIn profile URL from name plus company domain, company name, or email. Cost: ~$0.10/call [spec].

name: deepline_person_from_email
description: Person from Email — reverse an email address into the person behind it: name, title, company, and LinkedIn URL. Cost: ~$0.12/call [spec].

email.description: Business/work email address to enrich. Personal webmail domains such as gmail.com are rejected.

name: deepline_person_job_change
description: Job Change Check — detect whether a contact has changed jobs by comparing their LinkedIn profile against the company domain you have on record. Cost: ~$0.15/call [spec].

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (/in/ format) of the contact to check.

current_domain.description: Bare domain of the company you have on record — used to detect a change.

name: deepline_phone_find
description: Find Mobile Phone — locate a validated mobile number with automatic region-based provider routing. Strongest coverage in US/CA and Western Europe. Cost: ~$0.50/call [spec].
